_about: The frozen Electron «bridge» builds' files that every release carries forward, so an OLD installed Electron copy of either app still finds, under the names it looks for, a file to update to — the bridge build, which hands the library over and installs the Rust build. scripts/bridge-assets.mjs reads this file; the release workflows download the files from `tag`, refuse any whose SHA-256 is not the one listed here, and publish them with the new release. The Electron program is no longer built.
